title: 🧩 Сборка контекста: to be
description: Вставь правильную форму глагола to be (am, is, are, was, were, will be, has been, is being).

items.sentence: The internet ___ a great source of information. (is)
The film ___ directed by a famous director last year. (was)
Yesterday at 6 PM, the students ___ taking their exam. (were)
My brother ___ a lawyer for 5 years. (has been)
Next month, a new art gallery ___ opened in our city. (will be)
The new smartphone ___ released next week. (will be)
The environment ___ destroyed by human activity. (is being)
The message ___ sent two hours ago. (was)
The Olympic Games ___ held every four years. (are)
The crime ___ already solved by the police. (has been)
